hero.eyebrow: GLOBAL BUSINESS ADVISORY | MARKET ENTRY | STRATEGIC REPRESENTATION
hero.subheadline: Turning market ambitions into sustainable cross-border growth.
hero.introduction: Teba Connects is a US headquartered global business advisory and market development Firm that helps organizations enter new markets, build strategic partnerships and accelerate cross-border growth. With deep regional expertise and a trusted network across the USA, Africa and the Middle East, we turn connections into opportunities and ambitions into sustainable impact.
hero.imageAlt: Teba H. Molla - Founder & CEO with Dubai Skyline

aboutTebaConnects.headline: Bridging the Gap Between Opportunity and Execution.
aboutTebaConnects.lead: International growth requires more than introductions: it takes market understanding, trusted stakeholders and sustained engagement.
aboutTebaConnects.description: Teba Connects was established to help close the gap between market opportunities and the relationships, institutional understanding and execution support required to pursue them. Organizations entering unfamiliar markets need credible partners, local intelligence and consistent follow-through—not introductions alone.

founderPreview.title: Meet Our Founder
founderPreview.headline: Experience That Opens Doors. Relationships That Create Opportunities.
founderPreview.name: Teba H. Molla
founderPreview.bio: A global connector with extensive experience in international trade, investment facilitation and strategic representation. Former Chief Representative, Dubai International Chamber for Ethiopia and the Horn of Africa, with a proven track record of building partnerships and unlocking opportunities across global markets.
founderPreview.quote: I believe in the power of connections to create opportunities, empower people and drive sustainable growth across borders.
